images.prompt: Create a refined naturalistic editorial dog portrait, native output exactly 1536 x 1024 pixels, landscape 3:2. One mature adult Pug, Silver, whole body entirely visible in an original relaxed three-quarter standing pose at dog-eye level. A mature adult Silver Pug around7kg, decidedly square compact cobby well-muscular body of moderate substance without obesity, neither excessively low on legs nor leggy, deep broad chest, firm level short back and balanced hindquarters. Proportionately round adult head without puppy dome, short blunt square muzzle not upturned, black fairly large nose with well-open nostrils. Moderate clearly defined forehead wrinkles never covering nose or eyes, no heavy over-nose roll. Dark round proportionate eyes with soft solicitous expression, never protruding or showing excessive white. Small thin soft black button ears folded forward close to skull, strong slightly arched muscular neck with sufficient length. Four strong straight moderate-length legs placed under body, balanced moderate stifle bend, compact feet with well-separated coherent toes and black nails. Very short fine smooth soft coat with clear pale cool silver-fawn hue uniformly across shoulders, the entire back and both flanks. Keep the back as pale and clear as the sides; only a definite very narrow black trace line along the spine, roughly a fine pencil-width line in visual effect, continuing toward the tail, is allowed. Individual black-tipped guard hairs elsewhere must be barely visible and scattered; they must not combine into a charcoal blanket, saddle, broad stripe, dark patch or dark shoulder/back overlay. The cool light silver-fawn base coat must remain plainly visible immediately on both sides of the narrow trace. Distinctly cold silver cast rather than warm apricot or yellow fawn; no blue dilution, white patches or merle. Clear black mask, black ears and restrained black cheek moles remain, black nose remains fully pigmented. Full natural high-set tail anatomically continuous from rump and tightly curled over one hip in one complete visible loop with identifiable full base and tip; not detached, docked or hidden. All four separate coherent paws grounded on a clear firm level path with visible toes, no grass or objects concealing them. Full natural tail anatomically attached, complete base and whole tip clear without obstruction. Ample natural margins around ears, nose, paws and tail. Setting: A firm pale garden path beside a quiet walled courtyard, muted old brick and low flowering herbs beyond the clear paws, soft neutral morning light that preserves the cool silver coat hue. Restrained lifelike fine fur texture, quiet field-guide elegance, crisp dog and softly receding background. Original composition not based on any photograph. No people, other animals, collar, leash, equipment, text, logos, watermark, plastic fur, oversized puppy head, extra limbs, malformed joints, floating feet or clipped extremities.

profileEvidence.author: B
profileEvidence.summary: Playful and affectionate, the Silver Pug shares the Pug’s lively, even-tempered companion character and strong interest in human company. Intelligence can go alongside a strong will in this sociable little dog. Its coat has a cool silver cast, contrasting with the dark mask and ears.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: A playful, affectionate companion, the Silver Pug combines lively charm and a strong will beneath a cool silver coat.
